script.spoken: Alaska Airlines Flight 261 dove into the Pacific Ocean. The pilots fought it for minutes, but all eighty eight aboard died. The tail's trim was driven by a single jackscrew. Its nut needed regular grease. Maintenance intervals had been stretched again and again. The threads wore away until the nut could no longer hold. The tail slipped, and the jet became uncontrollable. Lubrication and wear checks were tightened across the fleet.
